sources.claim: Draft202012Validator validates instances against explicit schemas; schema validity does not establish external truth.
Check acyclicity before using deterministic topological graph ordering; a graph does not establish provenance legitimacy.
RFC 8785 implementation emits canonical UTF-8 bytes within its domain; canonicalization is not a signature or identity proof.
JCS specifies deterministic JSON serialization; typed equality and exact Git-blob byte hashes retain separate contracts.
